The '''1932–33 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by three points over nearest rival [[Motherwell F.C.|Motherwell]]. [[Greenock Morton F.C.|Morton]] and [[East Stirlingshire F.C.|East Stirlingshire]] finished 19th and 20th respectively and were relegated to the [[1933–34 Scottish Division Two]].
